relationships.subject: SLC45A4
relationships.evidence_quote: Mice lacking SLC45A4 show normal mechanosensitivity but reduced sensitivity to noxious heat- and algogen-induced tonic pain that is associated with reduced excitability of C-polymodal nociceptors.

key_findings: GWAS of chronic pain intensity in UK Biobank identified SLC45A4 as a pain locus, replicated in MVP and FinnGen.
SLC45A4 is a plasma membrane polyamine transporter expressed in all DRG neuron subtypes; knockout mice have reduced heat and algogen pain and reduced C-polymodal nociceptor excitability.
